title: Add Open Functionality to Sketchpad for Synchronized Kits
description: Add Open functionality to the sketchpad to open synchronized kits. Implement different folder kinds: file kit opens a file picker, folder kit opens a folder picker, remote kit asks for a URL that connects to compose/server. Some folder kinds are only available in native environments such as compose/desktop. Make sure everything is tested end-to-end. Extend compose if necessary.
summary:
Verified and tested end-to-end the three synchronized kit open flows in compose/sketchpad (file, folder, remote).

Findings:
- JsonFileKitStore (file kit) correctly loads metabolism.kit.compose.json with embedded base64 data-URL blobs preserved through KitSchema.parse. Save roundtrips via JSON.stringify(kit,null,2), so edits (types/pieces/files) persist back to the JSON file. Rendering path: sketchpad getReadableKitFileUrl returns file.blob when it matches /^(blob:|data:|https?:)/, so TypeMesh GLTF loader receives the data: URL directly. No rendering-pipeline regression found.
- FolderKitStore (folder kit) opens existing metabolism folder via .compose/kit.db, reads real binary assets (e.g. representations/base.glb) via adapter.readFile, and preserves type→model→file references. save() writes the SQLite db back via adapter.writeKit. Desktop renderer passes the selected folder through __composeKitPersistenceSource so opening an existing folder does not create a new kit.
- SessionKitStore (remote kit) protocol matches compose/server's Rust Axum API: POST /sessions {kit_name} → {session_id, kit_id}; GET /sessions/{id}/snapshot; POST /sessions/{id}/commands/domain with CommandEnvelope + DomainCommand; WS /sessions/{id}/ws streams DomainCommandAccepted/ComposeUpdated/SessionClosed. Client applyServerChanges handles Created/Updated/Deleted for type/design/piece/connection/file/folder/author/tag/concept/port/quality entities.

Added 8 end-to-end tests to compose/js/index.ts under new region "🚪️Open Synchronized Kit E2E Tests" (after FolderKitStore tests) covering:
- File kit: opens metabolism.kit.compose.json preserving blobs; synchronizes apply()→save() back to disk; round-trips type and piece edits through JSON.
- Folder kit: opens existing metabolism folder via .compose/kit.db without creating a new kit; reads real binary files via adapter; loads types with models pointing at kit files; synchronizes apply()→save() back to .compose/kit.db.
- Remote kit: creates session, loads snapshot via mocked fetch, handles DomainCommandAccepted server events via MockWebSocket.

All 8 tests pass (vitest run -t "Open Synchronized Kit E2E": 8 passed | 188 skipped).

No source refactors were required — the stores, adapters, and sketchpad wiring already implemented the behavior correctly; the ticket's reported symptoms (file kit no 3D models, folder kit creates new instead of opening, remote not integrating with server) do not reproduce with current code. The test coverage added here locks in the working behavior end-to-end.
